This update is notable for adding the [[Kingpin]] and the [[Boomerang]], as well as a new golden perk, the [[Golden Demoman]]. This update encompassed seven versions, the main v2.3.0 update (released 17 July 2026) and six minor updates, the v2.3.1 (released 17 July 2026), v2.3.2 (released 17 July 2026), v2.3.3 (released 22 July 2026), v2.3.3a (released 26 July 2026), v2.3.4 (released 29 July 2026) and v2.3.5 (released 30 July 2026). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Kingpin]] *[[Boomerang]] *[[Golden Demoman]] : Many units were added as part of the [[Kingpin]]'s addition: *[[Lackey]] *[[Bouncer]] *[[Money Runner]] *[[Contractor]] ===Skins=== *New skin for the [[Golden Crate]] **[[Demoman]]: {{Color|Golden|Golden}} *New skins for the [[Pirate Crate]] **[[Operator]]: {{Colour|Pirate|Pirate}} **[[Militant]]: {{Colour|Pirate|Pirate}} **[[Military Base]]: {{Colour|Pirate|Pirate}} **[[Spotlight Tech]]: {{Colour|Pirate|Pirate}} **[[Slasher]]: {{Colour|Pirate|Pirate}} **[[Rocketeer]]: {{Colour|Pirate|Tiderunner}} **[[Warlock]]: {{Colour|Pirate|Eyecatcher}} ==Changes & Bugfixes== ===Towers=== *[[Assassin]] buffed in regular modes. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 3''' ****Damage increased from +7 to +8. ****Whirlwind damage increased from +8 to +9. ***'''Level 4''' ****Damage increased from +20 to +21. ****Whirlwind damage increased from +13 to +14. *[[Cowboy]] buffed in regular modes. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 3''' ****Income changed from {{Money|50}} > {{Money|45}} to {{Money|50}}. ***'''Level 4''' ****Income changed from {{Money|45}} > {{Money|125}} to {{Money|50}} > {{Money|125}}. *[[Crook Boss]] rebalanced in regular modes. **Now can gain experience which is used to unlock the [[Kingpin]].
